mapper.select: SELECT A.ACCOUNT_ID, U.USER_NO, A.INST_ID, A.DEPT_ID, A.LOGIN_ID, A.PASSWORD, A.CREATE_DT, A.UPDATE_DT, A.DEL_YN, A.CREATE_ID, A.UPDATE_ID, A.ACCOUNT_STATUS_CD, A.PWD_FAIL_CNT, A.PWD_CHANGE_DT, A.IS_SYSTEM, U.user_name FROM T1000_ACCOUNT A JOIN t1000_user U ON A.user_no = U.user_no WHERE A.LOGIN_ID = #{loginId} AND A.PASSWORD = #{password} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N'
